scope: Count-only prospective information-set audit. No model, revision quantile, coverage optimisation or benchmark score is estimated.
selection_status: Follow-up after observing annual and phase results. Any subsequent performance evaluation is retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample, not an untouched holdout.
target: Annual published reference at month18, same definition as the preceding analyses.
primary_origin: Actual availability date of the annual snapshot selected at a fixed information-age cutoff. Data are assumed available on that calendar date; training targets must have completed their18month window strictly before this date.
reference_maturity: max(reference-end plus18 calendar months, actual availability of the selected reference file). This prevents using a retrospectively selected as-of reference before the selection window has closed.
origin_sensitivity: Decision at the end of the nominal information-age month, with references mature by that close.
training_pool: All age-specific archived annual counts with a valid18month reference; older endpoints outside the main evaluation period permitted. No requirement for availability at other ages, no future balanced-cohort filtering, no duplication across flows or overlapping releases.
test_period: NZ monthly endpoints January2019–March2025; AU quarterly endpoints2019Q1–2025Q1. Paired-country quarter-end subset disclosed separately.
threshold_interpretation: Illustrative warm-up sizes, not claims of statistical adequacy. Counts differ by release frequency; compare elapsed history and nonoverlapping annual windows.
recent_history: Separately count eligible reference-year endpoints in the trailing36 and60months at each decision origin. These windows include the maturity delay; do not interpret as36/60 available training observations.
overlap_check: Maximum number of nonoverlapping12month counting windows by earliest-end greedy selection; not an estimated effective sample size or a claim of statistical independence.
purged_sensitivity: Also count training annual endpoints at least12months before the current target endpoint; this removes overlap of counting windows with the current target, not all production/model dependence.
tail_resolution: Report0.025*n and0.05*n expected marginal tail counts as arithmetic context for central95/90% empirical intervals under an ideal stationary continuous distribution. These are not observed events or guarantees.
decision_outputs: Test start/end/count, nonoverlap capacity, train-count range, phase composition, origin sensitivity, common test opportunities and archives excluded by age or reference availability.
